text:
sara: Starting v2 rollout for /api/compose in prod now. conservative ramp, extra attention to tenant pins and streaming fallback. docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/rls/compose-v2-cutover

deploy-bot: Canary job 3678901234 started. slices: 5% -> 20% -> 50%. Auto-rollback thresholds preconfigured.

ben: quick check  do we have an enterprise holdlist applied? want to ensure large customers stay on v1 until notified.

sara: yes, holdlist `enterprise_hold_v2.csv` loaded. but note: last-minute normalization bug could bypass pins; ops please watch pinlist.

irene: ops taking handoff for 45m. assigning @irene as primary eyes. adding streaming-error and compose-diff alerts to the watch.

ops-sre: noticed tenant t-300 showing errors (unexpected v2 frames). pinlist shows t-300 present but with uppercase ID variant. normalizing tenant keys now.

deploy-bot: Action recommended: `deploybot pin --add t-300 --route /api/compose`

irene: applied pin for t-300 and applied a per-tenant shim: `deploybot route-shim --tenant t-300 --to v1-shim --ttl 3600`. errors for t-300 drop to 0 in 5m.

ben: good catch. recording operator commands used:
```
# verify pinlist
deploybot pinlist --route /api/compose
# apply pin
deploybot pin --add t-300 --route /api/compose
# per-tenant shim
deploybot route-shim --tenant t-300 --to v1-shim --ttl 3600
```

sara: metrics: aggregate 5xx = 0.04%, compose-diff regression samples = 0.8% (small spike in slice-2). Investigating model fallback logs.

ops-sre: traced spike to KV warmup on slice-2; fallback rate briefly hit 1.2% for a 3-minute window then returned to baseline. no sustained regression.

irene: decision: keep rollout moving but keep per-tenant shims active for any enterprise ID normalization mismatches. rollback criteria: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 20m OR compose-diff > 2% aggregated for 15m OR streaming-errors > 1% for 10m. Manual sign-off by @sara or @ben required for full rollback.

sara: noted. asking SDK leads to publish compatibility note and push patch for client normalization where needed. tagging @alex-mobile.

deploy-bot: Canary job 3678901234 progressed to 50% slices. No auto-rollback triggered. Job id recorded.

ben: post-cutover tasks: 1) audit pinlist normalization 2) add tenant-id normalization preflight to ramp controller 3) include per-tenant shim examples in runbook.

irene: handback kept to ops until 3678904834 for post-cutover watch. will remove temporary shims after TTL unless flagged. closing this window unless alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
